proposal.description: The S_RUN window advances only on cycles whose blanked sample is faulted, so clean cycles never push older faulted cycles out of the run window.
proposal.reason: In S_RUN, an intermittent overcurrent (for example one faulted cycle in four) makes fault_count_run_out keep climbing instead of settling near a quarter of the window. window_trip then asserts once the total reaches trip_run, which a true trailing 16-cycle window would never reach.

proposal.description: The soft-start window advances only on cycles whose blanked sample is faulted, so clean soft-start cycles never age faulted cycles out of the 32-cycle window.
proposal.reason: In S_SS with sparse overcurrent cycles, fault_count_ss_out grows with the total number of faulted cycles since entry instead of the number in the trailing 32. window_trip_SS asserts once that total reaches trip_ss.

proposal.description: Only the run shift register is qualified by the cycle-boundary strobe. The run count is updated on every clock in S_RUN, so one faulted switching cycle is counted once per clock instead of once per cycle.
proposal.reason: In S_RUN, while the blanked comparator sample is high, fault_count_run_out goes up on every clock and wraps. window_trip asserts within a few clocks of the first faulted cycle instead of after trip_run faulted cycles.

proposal.description: Only the soft-start shift register is qualified by the cycle-boundary strobe. fault_count_ss is updated on every clock in S_SS, so one faulted cycle is counted once per clock.
proposal.reason: In S_SS, while the blanked comparator sample is high, fault_count_ss_out goes up on every clock. window_trip_SS asserts a few clocks after the first faulted cycle instead of after trip_ss faulted cycles.

proposal.description: The soft-start trip is masked on the cycle-boundary strobe clock, as if fault_count_ss were mid-update there, although the count is a register and is valid on that clock.
proposal.reason: In S_SS, when the soft-start count is at or above trip_ss (for example after trip_ss is lowered, or while the supervisor has not yet left S_SS), window_trip_SS drops low for one clock on every rising edge of pwm_sync instead of staying high.

proposal.description: The soft-start window trip is also qualified by the live comparator flag ('overcurrent still present'), so a soft-start window that holds trip_ss faulted cycles does not trip while cp_sync is low.
proposal.reason: In S_SS, after the window count reaches trip_ss on a valley sample, window_trip_SS stays low while cp_sync is low, for example once the comparator has released after high-side turn-on. It asserts only when the comparator is high again, instead of as soon as the count reaches trip_ss.
